airhockey.name: Freeze
airhockey.desc: Freeze the other paddle for a moment.

airhockey.name: Giant Paddle
airhockey.desc: Your paddle grows huge for 5 seconds.

airhockey.name: Split Puck
airhockey.desc: The puck splits in two. Either one can score.

seabattle.name: Radar
seabattle.desc: Scan a 3×3 patch of sea to see if a ship hides there. You still fire after.

seabattle.name: Airstrike
seabattle.desc: Instead of one shot, hit 5 cells of a row at once.

seabattle.name: Hit-back Mine
seabattle.desc: Hide a mine in your sea. Whoever fires on it gets one of their own ships hit.

fourinarow.name: Drop a Bomb
fourinarow.desc: Your next disc clears the 3×3 around where it lands, then drops into place.

fourinarow.name: Flip a Piece
fourinarow.desc: Use your turn to turn one of their discs into yours (it can't make four by itself).

fourinarow.name: Block a Column
fourinarow.desc: Pick a column they can't play on their next turn. You still drop a disc.
